translations.web: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.
translations.bsb: Therefore, since we have now been justified by His blood, how much more shall we be saved from wrath through Him!
translations.kjv: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.
translations.asv: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, shall we be saved from the wrath of God through him.
